title: Enterprise GIS Workbench, GeoJSON Zones & Deck.gl Analytics
name: Enterprise GIS Workbench, GeoJSON Zones & Deck.gl Analytics
user_prompt: Build an enterprise Web GIS spatial analytics workbench centered on New York City. Include a basemap layer switcher (roadmap, satellite, hybrid, terrain), GeoJSON district boundary polygons styled by capacity metrics with smooth zoom-to-bounds when a district is selected, and a high-performance deck.gl overlay (ScatterplotLayer or HexagonLayer via GoogleMapsOverlay) visualizing thousands of infrastructure sensor points. Provide an interactive Terra Draw polygon tool so analysts can draw a custom study zone on the map to dynamically filter points inside the polygon, compute summary metrics, and inspect terrain elevation via the Elevation API.
